description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Accuracy@1 on geometry problems and tree width for rollout search. The x-axis is labeled "Tree Width" with a linear scale, ranging from 5 to 40, and has tick labels at intervals of 5, specifically 5, 10, 20, and 40. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)", also with a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20, namely 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100. Two lines are depicted in the plot: a blue dashed line representing GPT-4o, and a blue solid line representing Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The GPT-4o line starts at approximately 19.4% at a tree width of 5, increases to around 38.7% at a tree width of 10, then decreases to about 32.3% at a tree width of 20, and finally drops to roughly 19.4% at a tree width of 40, exhibiting an inverted U-shaped trend. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet line begins at around 29% at a tree width of 5, rises to approximately 48.7% at a tree width of 10, followed by a decline to about 37.1% at a tree width of 20, and ends at roughly 29% at a tree width of 40, also displaying an inverted U-shaped trend.
